title: Sound-Reactive Sculpture with Dynamic Difficulty
prompt:
Create an interactive 3D sound-reactive sculpture using Three.js in a single HTML file. The sculpture consists of a central core surrounded by orbiting geometric elements that react to a simulated audio frequency spectrum.

## Scene Setup
- Dark background (0x0a0a0a). Camera at position (0, 5, 12) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (0x222244, intensity 0.3) and a point light (0xffffff, intensity 1.5) at (5, 10, 5).
- Central core: An IcosahedronGeometry(1.5, 2) with MeshStandardMaterial, wireframe mode, color 0x00ffaa, emissive 0x003322.
- Orbiting rings: Create 3 concentric rings of small spheres (SphereGeometry 0.15). Ring 1: 12 spheres at radius 3. Ring 2: 18 spheres at radius 5. Ring 3: 24 spheres at radius 7. Each ring orbits at different speeds.
- Each sphere should have MeshStandardMaterial with emissive properties.

## Simulated Audio System
- Since we cannot use real audio, simulate a frequency spectrum using sine waves. Create an array of 64 frequency bins.
- Each bin value = Math.abs(Math.sin(time * (0.5 + binIndex * 0.1) + binIndex * 0.3)) where time is elapsed seconds.
- The simulated audio drives the sculpture's behavior.

## Difficulty Levels
- Implement 3 difficulty levels: 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'. Start at 'easy'.
- Easy: Spheres scale between 0.5x and 1.5x based on frequency. Core rotation speed = 0.5 rad/s. Ring orbit speeds: 0.3, 0.2, 0.1 rad/s.
- Medium: Spheres scale between 0.3x and 2.5x. Core rotation speed = 1.0 rad/s. Ring orbit speeds: 0.6, 0.4, 0.2 rad/s. Spheres also move radially ±0.5 units based on frequency.
- Hard: Spheres scale between 0.1x and 3.5x. Core rotation speed = 2.0 rad/s. Ring orbit speeds: 1.2, 0.8, 0.4 rad/s. Spheres move radially ±1.5 units. Core geometry morphs (vertices displaced by frequency data).

## Color Modes
- Implement 3 color modes: 'spectrum', 'pulse', 'monochrome'. Start at 'spectrum'.
- Spectrum: Each sphere's hue = (its index / total spheres in ring) mapped to HSL.
- Pulse: All spheres share the same hue that cycles over time (hue = (time * 0.1) % 1).
- Monochrome: All spheres are cyan (0x00ffff) with varying brightness based on frequency.

## User Interactions
- Press '1', '2', '3' to switch difficulty to easy, medium, hard respectively.
- Press 'C' to cycle through color modes (spectrum -> pulse -> monochrome -> spectrum).
- Press 'Space' to toggle pause/resume of the simulation.
- Click on the central core (raycasting) to trigger an explosion effect: all spheres rapidly move outward to 2x their ring radius over 1 second, then return over 1 second. Track explosion state.
- Press 'R' to reset everything to initial state (easy, spectrum, not paused, no explosion).
- Mouse movement (mousemove) controls camera orbit: horizontal mouse position maps to camera angle around Y axis (0 to 2*PI across screen width), camera stays at radius 12 from origin, height 5.

## HUD Elements
- Top-left: Display current difficulty level, color mode, and whether paused.
- Top-right: Display average frequency value (average of all 64 bins, rounded to 3 decimal places).
- Bottom-center: Display total sphere count and current FPS.
- Style HUD with semi-transparent dark background, white text, monospace font.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields:
  - difficulty: 'easy' | 'medium' | 'hard'
  - colorMode: 'spectrum' | 'pulse' | 'monochrome'
  - paused: boolean
  - elapsedTime: number (seconds since start, stops incrementing when paused)
  - avgFrequency: number (average of 64 bins)
  - coreRotationSpeed: number (current rad/s)
  - ringOrbitSpeeds: [number, number, number]
  - sphereCount: number (total: 12+18+24 = 54)
  - explosionActive: boolean
  - explosionProgress: number (0 to 1, where 0.5 is max expansion)
  - cameraAngle: number (radians)
  - ring1AvgScale: number (average scale of ring 1 spheres)
  - ring2AvgScale: number (average scale of ring 2 spheres)
  - ring3AvgScale: number (average scale of ring 3 spheres)
  - coreVerticesDisplaced: boolean (true only in hard mode)
  - fps: number

Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame.
physics_constraints: Sphere scaling must stay within difficulty-defined bounds. Ring orbit speeds must match difficulty settings exactly. Explosion effect must complete in exactly 2 seconds (1s out, 1s back). Camera must maintain radius 12 from origin. Frequency values must be in range [0, 1]. All numerical state values must be finite (no NaN/Infinity).
